description: This Dart file defines a Flutter widget for displaying a captcha input dialog. It includes a stateful widget `CaptchaDialog` that shows either a network image or a custom widget (like a WebView) for CAPTCHA, with input field and action buttons. It also provides a helper function to show the dialog and retrieve the entered CAPTCHA value.

classes.name: CaptchaDialog
classes.description: A stateful widget that displays a CAPTCHA image (from URL or custom widget), input field, and action buttons, handling user interactions and callbacks.

methods.name: createState
methods.description: Creates the mutable state for the `CaptchaDialog` widget.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes the state, particularly the text editing controller.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Disposes of the text editing controller.

methods.name: _handleCancel
methods.description: Handles user cancellation, invoking callback and closing dialog.

methods.name: _handleSubmit
methods.description: Validates input, then triggers callback and closes dialog with input value.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget UI for the CAPTCHA dialog, including title, message, CAPTCHA image/widget, input field, and action buttons.

methods.name: showCaptchaDialog
methods.description: Shows the CAPTCHA dialog and returns a Future resolving with the input CAPTCHA string or null if canceled.
